paper_title: Shedding Infrared Light on QCD Axion and ALP Dark Matter with JWST
suggested_experiment_name: JWST NIRSpec IFU ALP DM decay (combined)
notes: Paper constrains axion-photon coupling g_agamma for ALP/QCD axion DM decaying to two photons in mass range 0.47-2.55 eV using JWST NIRSpec IFU. Coupling type unambiguous (AxionPhoton). However, no numerical table of limit values is provided in the text; the exclusion curves are only shown in Figs. 1-2. From the schematic axis (Fig.1), limits are roughly at the 1e-10 to few x 1e-11 GeV^-1 level. The data points given are a rough placeholder spanning the mass range at ~1e-10 GeV^-1; actual per-mass values could not be read reliably.
